query:
INSERT INTO org_plans (org_id, plan_id, source, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3,
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $4::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $4::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
         ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
